newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-ANI says Ellicott report due soon.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-ANI says Ellicott report due soon.

text.p: Heavy engineering firm Australian National Industries Ltd said on Tuesday it expected to receive a report about its woeful investment in the Holter water treatment business in the very near future.

"It is coming very soon. It is imminent," ANI managing director Peter Stancliffe told Reuters in response to a question about when the report by high profile lawyer Bob Ellicott would be ready for consideration by ANI's directors.
Ellicott, a former national attorney-general and federal judge, was initially scheduled to release the report by the end of 1996.

ANI wrote down the value of the German-based Holter business by A$234 million in its 1995/96 balance sheet and the business was at the centre of the company's A$213.2 million net loss in the same year.
